activity.notes: Representative early-eleventh-century point around Murasaki Shikibu's entry into court service and literary activity. The point does not claim an exact composition date for the Tale of Genji.

sources.title: The Tale of Genji — World History Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The article identifies Murasaki Shikibu as a Heian court lady and author of The Tale of Genji, written in the early eleventh century.
